note: Webster County (Iowa) publishes its zoning only as static PDF maps: the county's 2019 Zoning Map (24x36 PDF) on the Planning & Zoning page, and the City of Fort Dodge zoning map PDF (2023 draft). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Webster County Iowa zoning returned only roads, boundaries, flood data, and a Massachusetts 'WebsterZoning' item that is a different Webster. The county Beacon (Schneider) viewer is not a public zoning service.
